title: Extend go_ioutil_reader with CountLines, AppendBytes, and FindLine
description: Brownfield Go task: add three new utility functions to the fileutil package.

task_spec.prompt:
Add three new functions to internal/fileutil/fileutil.go. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

  func CountLines(path string) (int, error)
    — reads the file at path
    — returns the number of non-empty lines (same definition as ReadLines)
    — returns (0, err) if the file cannot be read

  func AppendBytes(path string, data []byte) error
    — opens path with O_APPEND|O_WRONLY|O_CREATE and mode 0o644
    — writes data and closes the file
    — returns any error encountered

  func FindLine(path string, prefix string) (string, error)
    — reads the lines using ReadLines
    — returns the first line that starts with prefix
    — returns ("", fmt.Errorf("not found: %s", prefix)) if no such line exists
    — propagates any read error

Add at least 4 tests for the new functions.
All 3 existing fixture tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: CountLines returns error for unreadable file
FindLine returns error when prefix not found
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `go test ./...` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
